import hashlib,json,sys,pathlib,re
key=sys.argv[1]
site=pathlib.Path('products/sites/software-award-brief')
live=pathlib.Path('products/services/software-awards/exposure')
existing=[p.name for p in site.iterdir()]
assert not any(re.fullmatch(r'[0-9a-f]{32}\.txt',n) for n in existing), existing
kf=site/(key+'.txt'); kf.write_bytes(key.encode())
h=lambda p: hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
checks=[]
checks.append(('index unchanged vs live',h(site/'index.html')==h(live/'live-index.html')=='fc27129485920cc4b1abb61aa05976ed95c4f5813d1a6d0277354e04ad25d5c6'))
checks.append(('llms unchanged vs live',h(site/'llms.txt')==h(live/'live-llms.txt')=='aed09c85322be9430cce86608d9833013f8fcb655384417294d15d1888d7ccf7'))
b=kf.read_bytes(); checks.append(('key body exact 32 lowercase hex, no newline',b==key.encode() and len(b)==32 and re.fullmatch(rb'[0-9a-f]{32}',b) is not None))
checks.append(('file inventory',sorted(p.name for p in site.iterdir())==sorted(['index.html','llms.txt',key+'.txt'])))
base=json.loads((live/'launch-baseline.json').read_text())
checks.append(('baseline records no prior IndexNow submission',base.get('indexnow')=='not submitted'))
out={'mission':'SOFTWARE-AWARD-INITIAL-DISCOVERY','site':'software-award-brief','key':key,'key_file':kf.name,'key_sha256':h(kf),'index_sha256':h(site/'index.html'),'llms_sha256':h(site/'llms.txt'),'checks':[{'check':c,'pass':bool(v)} for c,v in checks],'passed':sum(bool(v) for _,v in checks),'total':len(checks),'planned_submission_after_approval_and_deploy':'GET https://api.indexnow.org/indexnow?url=https%3A%2F%2Fgloballand-software-award-brief.global-land.workers.dev%2F&key='+key+' exactly once, after FETCH of the public key file returns the exact 32-byte body','not_established':['submission','indexing','traffic','requests','revenue'],'observation_window_end':'2026-11-21T05:00:35Z'}
p=pathlib.Path('products/services/software-awards/discovery/manifest.json'); p.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True); p.write_text(json.dumps(out,indent=1))
print(json.dumps(out,indent=1))
